args.title: Historical note — Wes ownership review evidence
args.body: On October 6, 2025, Wes independently operated the Mosaic Commerce production live-ramp slice as traffic reached 16.0 million data points per minute. The ramp completed without a production change or rollback, while key health and safety checks remained at baseline. This event was retained as formal evidence for Wes’s later metrics-router ownership review.
